mil3.8:1.2: Jānāsi kho mahārāja sampati kā velā ti. -
mil3.8:1.3: Āma bhante, jānāmi, sampati paṭhamo yāmo atikkanto, majjhimo yāmo vattati, ukkā padīpiyanti, cattāri paṭākāni āṇattāni, gamissanti bhaṇḍato rājadeyyā ti. -
mil3.8:2.1: Yonakā evam-āhaṃsu: Kallo si mahārāja, paṇḍito bhikkhūti.
mil3.8:2.2: Āma bhaṇe, paṇḍito thero, ediso ācariyo bhaveyya mādiso ca antevāsī, nacirass' eva paṇḍito dhammaṃ ājāneyyāti. -
mil3.8:2.3: Tassa pañhaveyyākaraṇena tuṭṭho rājā theraṃ Nāgasenaṃ satasahassagghanakena kambalena acchādetvā: Bhante Nāgasena, ajjatagge te aṭṭhasataṃ bhattaṃ paññāpemi, yaṃ kiñci antepure kappiyaṃ tena ca pavāremīti āha. -
mil3.8:2.5: Jānāmi bhante Nāgasena jīvasi, api ca attānañ-ca rakkha mamañ-ca rakkhāhi;
mil3.8:2.6: kathaṃ attānaṃ rakkhasi: Nāgaseno Milindaṃ rājānaṃ pasādesi na ca kiñci alabhīti parāpavādo āgaccheyyāti, evaṃ attānaṃ rakkha;
mil3.8:2.7: kathaṃ mamaṃ rakkhasi: Milindo rājā pasanno pasannākāraṃ na karotīti parāpavādo āgaccheyyāti, evaṃ mamaṃ rakkhāhīti. -
mil3.8:2.9: Seyyathā pi bhante sīho migarājā suvaṇṇapañjare pakkhitto pi bahimukho yeva hoti,
mil3.8:2.10: evam-eva kho 'haṃ bhante kiñcāpi agāraṃ ajjhāvasāmi, bahimukho yeva pana acchāmi,
mil3.8:2.11: sace 'haṃ bhante agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajeyyaṃ na ciraṃ jīveyyaṃ, bahū me paccatthikā ti.
mil3.8:3.1: Atha kho āyasmā Nāgaseno Milindassa rañño pañhaṃ vissajjetvā uṭṭhāy' āsanā sanghārāmaṃ agamāsi.
mil3.8:3.2: Acirapakkante ca āyasmante Nāgasene Milindassa rañño etad-ahosi:
mil3.8:3.3: Kiṃ mayā pucchitaṃ, kiṃ bhadantena vissajjitan-ti.
mil3.8:3.5: Sabbaṃ mayā supucchitaṃ, sabbaṃ bhadantena suvissajjitan-ti.
mil3.8:3.6: Āyasmato pi Nāgasenassa sanghārāmaṃ gatassa etad-ahosi:
mil3.8:3.7: Kiṃ Milindena raññā pucchitaṃ, kiṃ mayā vissajjitan-ti.
mil3.8:3.9: Sabbaṃ Milindena raññā supucchitaṃ, sabbaṃ mayā suvissajjitan-ti.
mil3.8:4.1: Atha kho āyasmā Nāgaseno tassā rattiyā accayena pubbanhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaram-ādāya yena Milindassa rañño nivesanaṃ ten' upasankami, upasankamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
mil3.8:4.2: Atha kho Milindo rājā āyasmantaṃ Nāgasenaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi, ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Milindo rājā āyasmantaṃ Nāgasenaṃ etad-avoca:
mil3.8:5.1: Mā kho bhadantassa evaṃ ahosi: Nāgaseno mayā pañhaṃ pucchito ti ten' eva somanassena na taṃ rattāvasesaṃ supīti, na te evaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ;
mil3.8:5.2: tassa mayhaṃ bhante taṃ rattāvasesaṃ etad-ahosi:
mil3.8:5.3: kiṃ mayā pucchitaṃ, kiṃ bhadantena vissajjitan-ti; sabbaṃ mayā supucchitaṃ, sabbaṃ bhadantena suvissajjitan-ti.
mil3.8:6.2: Mā kho mahārājassa evaṃ ahosi: Milindassa rañño mayā pañho vissajjito ti ten' eva somanassena taṃ rattāvasesaṃ vītināmesīti, na te evaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ;
mil3.8:6.3: tassa mayhaṃ mahārāja taṃ rattāvasesaṃ etad-ahosi:
mil3.8:6.4: kiṃ Milindena raññā pucchitaṃ, kiṃ mayā vissajjitan-ti; sabbaṃ Milindena raññā supucchitaṃ, sabbaṃ mayā suvissajjitan-ti. - Iti ha te mahānāgā aññamaññassa subhāsitaṃ samanumodiṃsūti.
